source_evidence: Exact player 'Yes lets head in for the night. we can Present evidence to Desen; investigate Tavosk and House Veldrake tomorrow'. Ordinary established package and actual secure overnight, no random roll necessary; rules-combat-recovery.md D245-246 standing pre-SR Psi Recovery and weighted rest, D325-326 Copper Hart accepted package precedent. D327~07:30 at Copper Hart, Orsaven, V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar reunited, coach/four horses cared for and safely stabled. Exact player 'Yes lets head in for the night. we can Present evidence to Desen; investigate Tavosk and House Veldrake tomorrow' authorizes routine return to established lodging, ordinary supper and overnight under prior 2gp package (two rooms, three non-V suppers, four horses care/stabling), and establishes tomorrow's intended direction without preplaying actual report, disclosure, visit, or investigation. Party returns safely D326 evening, pays2gp once for D326→327; personal purse2049gp8sp6cp→2047gp8sp6cp, no other fee, ration/feed deduction, or new discretionary spend. Cirren voluntarily recounts actual ferry/warehouse/broker findings over supper to Mara; Mara now informed of actual evidence including Tavosk and House Veldrake, not hidden DM truths. V still has temporarily taken canvas apron/cap, no further clothing change or ownership claim. Under standing D245-246 pre-rest ruling V uses Psi Recovery once before qualifying Short Rest: Psi3/6→4/6, PsiRecovery1→0; no Second Wind because HP full. Actual peaceful secure overnight qualifies Short Rest for all and adds2 weighted LR units from0/6 to2/6; no full Long Rest, no extra repeated Short Rests or Psi uses. V MP6→7/7, Sup3→4/4, PsiRecovery0→1/1, Psi4/6, PastLife2/3 and freeWhispers0/1 unchanged; active Cirren/Fenar Psychic Whispers expired D326~23:05 normally. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 cloak+Luckstone; Cirren51/51 AC19 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 boots +1Shield, no concentration; Fenar59/59 AC16 HD6/6 Rage4/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40 breastplate/Insignia, natural+9/1d6+6 base or1d6+8 raging mechanical greataxe unchanged. All other HP and resources unchanged; no HD used. Rations21/feed28 retained due inn package, LR2/6. Routine D327 Tamsin contact under standing once-per-dawn instruction; no specific estate transaction, new reported result or Meret reply asserted. Evidence: Cirren holds original lot27 invoice36gp from storehouse2 and original sealed14gp acknowledgement identified by broker as commercial petition delegate Noldren Tavosk (public Exchange district petitions office). V holds handwritten notes accurately transcribing broker ledger Lot27 inward lighter/ferry Storehouse1→2 sale36gp; D321 L-9 household agent instruction to continue consignments landed before assessment/no assessed duties on bill, D322 paid24gp receipt, agent stamp sketch, matching L-9 House Veldrake client index. V witnessed landing official purse, ferry/lighter transfer, warehouse payment and sale, read warehouse fee book D3206gp+D3238gp charged through broker reimbursement, originals left. These support concrete investigation of smuggling/paid political influence/knowing household purchases; individual patron identity, broker personal name, exact proceeds, enacted exemptions and knowledge of Quenwood's murders unproved. Quenwood conviction/life sentence upheld/assets frozen; paymaster holds48gp, notification promised not verified sent, no restitution distributed. No evidence yet presented to Sgt Rill Desen/customs, no investigation or visit to Tavosk/Veldrake actually undertaken. No unseen hostile reaction or departure asserted. Skiff freed/jelly defeated, Meret referral delivered but no hire/contract. Ossent royal councillor sponsors preliminary reciprocal intelligence talks, confidential Kestrel copies retained, actual royal decision pending; Kestrel originals retained. Crown frontier commission300+1300 contingent, Orseld lead outstanding; conditional western service-house grant signed not deed, route48road+12rough miles approx3days each way, Coris packet dispatch/receipt/300gp assessment pending, optional800 field milestone. Magic commissions balance520 due upon actual completion target353; Elara Caereth, Severin assent unconfirmed. V dice delegated. Current morning ready to undertake player-declared plan, next action to present evidence to Desen, investigate Tavosk and House Veldrake in play. No already-delivered report, extra rest or future results.
